objective: C1: fresh invocation recovers project-owned state using observed reads. C2: predeclared gate decides this run automatically. Output only a release/state receipt, not the AT03 index.
excluded_scope: No held pilot data, census, frozen file edits or accepted test reruns
No network tools, extra workers or retry; one CLI invocation and one DeepSeek review
Worker is read-only; controller owns exclusive artifact writeback and CAS checkpoint
acceptance_criteria: Rules in packets/at05-recovery-01.md are fixed before invocation and bound by prelaunch hashes.
Recovery tool must capture real root ascent, exact reads/hashes, current checkpoint integrity and time; CLI trace must show its successful invocation.
Receipt exactly equals project_id/release/frozen_file_count/observed_checkpoint from captured accepted inputs.
One independent DeepSeek review PASS confidence>=0.80<=1, correct fields/types, no anomalies, completed, zero tools, different session from worker.
Automatic gate produces PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN with named reasons; no coordinator-supplied verdict. Canonical receipt only on PASS and exact-byte equality.
C1/C2 separate; full-loop promotion only after all gates and CAS commit succeed. Missing trace or review is UNCERTAIN; contradictory output is FAIL.
verification_route: Existing DSH headless DeepSeek Flash text runner; supplied evidence review only.
resume_action: Read packets/at05-recovery-01.md. Only use python artifacts/at05/experiment.py observe, then return the receipt JSON without extra commands. Controller handles verification/writeback/checkpoint.
